title: Opening the Three Deuces with his own band and asking for a raise
summary: Zutty's band at the Three Deuces had Vernon York, Horace Eubanks, Leonard Bibb and Henry Gordon and lasted a year; Marge made him ask Sam Beer for a raise.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well Zutt y, should we go to when you opened at Three Deuces with your own band?
That was the one with Vernon York was it?
Vernon York and Horace Eubanks and Leonard Bibb on bass. And Henry Gordon on piano and myself on drums.
Well how did that, that last?
Oh that must have lasted about a year.

Yes. Roy came in after that. Because Marge told me, why don't you ask Sam Beer for a raise? And so I finally got up the nerve to do it. Because I told her, I said, all the guys are working just like I am and everything like that. I said, it's alright. But she said, no, ask him for a raise. So I did. I asked old Sam Beer for a raise and he said, I'm not only going to give you a raise, I'm going to take you on a vacation with me. (LAUGHTER).
What was his second name, Zutty?
